description_en: Creates a member of the resource account type by calling CreateResourceAccount
description_zh: 调用CreateResourceAccount创建资源账号类型的成员
name: CreateResourceAccount

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the member.

Length: 2 to 50 characters.

Format: Can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), hyphens (-), and spaces.

The display name must be unique within the resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
成员显示名称。

长度范围：2~50个字符或汉字。

格式：允许输入汉字、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和空格。

成员显示名称在资源目录内必须唯一
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent folder
parameters.name: parent_folder_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the billing account. If you leave this parameter empty, the newly created member pays for its own resource consumption
parameters.help_zh: 结算账号ID。置空则采用新创建的成员自主结算
parameters.name: payer_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the account name. If you leave this parameter empty, the system randomly generates a prefix.

<props="china">Length: 2 to 50 characters.</props>

<props="intl">Length: 2 to 37 characters.</props>

Format: Can contain letters, digits, and special characters `_.-`. Must start and end with a letter or digit. Consecutive special characters `_.-` are not allowed.

The full account name is in the format of <AccountNamePrefix>@<ResourceDirectoryId>.aliyunid.com, such as `alice@rd-3G****.aliyunid.com`.

The account name must be unique within the resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
账号名称前缀。置空则系统随机生成。

<props="china">长度范围：2~50个字符或汉字。</props>

<props="intl">长度范围：2~37个字符。</props>

格式：允许输入英文字母、数字和特殊字符`_.-`，必须以英文字母或数字开头和结尾，且不能输入连续的特殊字符`_.-`。

完整账号名称的格式为<AccountNamePrefix>@<ResourceDirectoryId>.aliyunid.com，例如：`alice@rd-3G****.aliyunid.com`

账号名称在资源目录内必须唯一
parameters.name: account_name_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The identity type of the member. Valid values:

resell (default): reseller account. The created member automatically establishes a reseller relationship with your reseller. You must use the management account to pay for the new member.
non_resell: non-reseller account. The created member is a regular Alibaba Cloud account that is not associated with your current reseller. The account purchases resources directly from Alibaba Cloud and pays for its own resource consumption.

This parameter is supported only for China site (Chinese mainland) reseller customers
parameters.help_zh:
成员的身份类型。取值：

resell（默认值）：分销账号。创建的成员将自动与您的分销商建立分销关系，同时您需要使用管理账号为新成员付款。
non_resell ：非分销账号。创建的成员为阿里云普通账号，与您当前的分销商无关联关系，该账号直接从阿里云购买资源，需自主付款。

该参数仅支持国际站分销客户
parameters.name: resell_account_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run for the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without actually creating the member. The check currently includes whether the current account is allowed to set the identity type of the member. If the check fails, the corresponding error code is returned.
false (default): sends the request. If the check passes, the member is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会实际创建成员。检查项当前包括当前账号是否允许设置成员的身份类型。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误码。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建成员
parameters.name: dry_run

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the member

JoinMethod.description_en:
The way in which the member joined the resource directory. Valid values:

invited: invited.
created: created
JoinMethod.description_zh:
成员加入方式。取值：

invited：邀请。
created：创建

JoinTime.description_en: The time when the member joined the resource directory (UTC)

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the member was last modified (UTC)

ResourceDirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the resource directory

Status.description_en: The join status of the member. The value CreateSuccess indicates that the member is created
Status.description_zh: 成员加入状态。取值为CreateSuccess，表示创建成功

Type.description_en: The type of the member. The value ResourceAccount indicates a resource account
Type.description_zh: 成员类型。取值为ResourceAccount，表示资源账号
